column1: # catalog/ci-test-value/infra-patterns.tsv — rule I3.pattern of the CI test value
# report (bin/lib/ci-test-value/rules.d/10-infra.sh). A failed unit whose log
# excerpt matches a row is infra: the runner or the network failed, not the test.
# Format: <POSIX ERE>\t<why>, one row per line, matched with LC_ALL=C grep -E,
# first match wins in file order. A line that starts with # is a comment. A row
# with a bad ERE is skipped. Match an error the tool prints, never a word a test
# assertion can print: "rate limit" alone also matches a FAIL line that expects it.
